inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn Japanese gothic 2D anime image. Keep strong ink outlines, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, matte skin, broad connected hair locks and painted backgrounds in every frame. No photorealistic fluid, PBR, plastic skin, 3D animation, random cuts, camera orbit, changing identities, extra people or extra limbs. GPT hovers in place, silver-white hair, two horns, exactly two MEMBRANOUS wings and one tail. Start from hands near chest. She immediately extends her RIGHT arm decisively toward screen LEFT and points her index finger along a clear attack line. One blue WATER dragon behind her turns its head toward that same screen-left line, pulls its neck back only slightly, then drives its head hard off screen LEFT, its continuous neck following. Her hair and gown recoil once after the dragon passes. Keep the dragon head beside GPT until it launches, never sweep the head across the lens or around the viewer. No full circle around GPT, no orbit, no second head or duplicate dragon. Fixed medium-wide camera, restrained single impact jolt as it launches. The dragon remains blue water and GPT remains human. Preserve the single roof hole and intact side/rear vault.
